title: a sops store's recipients file (<stem>.recipients.yaml, beside the store)
description: The age public keys the store is encrypted to, by name: one per machine or user, and one recovery recipient (spec §11.5). Public keys only, never a secret. hapi secrets check and every lifecycle command compare it with the store's own sops metadata. Change it only through `hapi secrets join`, `add-machine`, `recover`, `revoke` and `new-recovery`. See docs/secrets.md#keys-and-recovery.

pq.description: true (the default): every recipient is post-quantum (age1pq1..., from age-keygen -pq). false: every recipient is classic X25519 (age1..., 62 characters), the trade-off for P-256 hardware plugins later. hapi refuses a mix either way.

name.description: A short name: a machine or user (laptop-alice, vm-hapi) or `recovery`.

kind.description: machine: a key generated where it lives, never copied. recovery: the break-glass key wrapped with the 10 words in recovery.age.

recipient.description: The age public key: post-quantum (age1pq1 + 1952 characters) or classic X25519 (age1 + 58 characters).
